Legal Information

Cancellation and Refund Policy

Ticket changes and refunds are handled fairly while protecting event commitments and payment costs.

Refund requests

Refund eligibility follows the deadline and conditions communicated with the selected ticket. Administrative and payment processing fees may not be refundable.

Ticket transfers

Tickets cannot be transferred without organizer approval and all approved changes must be completed before the announced transfer deadline.

Program changes

Speaker, schedule, room, and workshop adjustments do not automatically qualify for a refund when the core event continues as planned.

Event cancellation

If the organizer cancels the event, affected participants will receive instructions through their registered email address regarding available remedies.

Last updated: August 1, 2026. Contact the organizer for the policy version that applies to your event.
